answer: You can return most items within **30 days** of delivery. Items must be unused, unwashed, with original tags and packaging intact. To start a return, go to **My Orders → Return Item** in your account. A prepaid return label will be emailed to you within 24 hours. International orders follow the same 30-day return window, but return shipping charges and any customs duties may be the customer's responsibility.

answer: Refunds are processed within **3–5 business days** after your returned item is received and inspected. The amount is credited back to your original payment method. For bank transfers it may take an additional 2–3 business days to appear in your account.

questions: Can I get a partial refund?
I only want to return one part of a set
answer: Yes, we offer partial refunds if you return only a portion of a multi-item order. The refund amount will be calculated based on the specific items returned. We cannot issue partial refunds for single items that are kept.

questions: Can I return underwear or swimwear?
answer: The following items **cannot be returned**: innerwear, swimwear, earrings (hygiene reasons), personalized or custom-made items, digital downloads, and items marked **Final Sale**. Perishable goods and hazardous materials are also non-returnable.

questions: How do I exchange an item?
Can I swap my order for a different size?
How does the exchange process work?
I want a different color, can I exchange?
answer: To exchange an item, go to **My Orders → Exchange Item** within 30 days of delivery. Select your preferred size or color and submit the request. We will ship the replacement once your original item is received. Exchanges are free for the first request per order.

questions: I received this as a gift, can I return it?
How do I return a gift?
answer: Yes, gifts can be returned! We can issue the refund as **Store Credit** to your account so the gift giver won't be notified. Contact support with the order number (usually on the packing slip) to initiate a gift return.

questions: How do I print the return label?
answer: You can reprint your return label at any time by going to **My Orders → Returns** and clicking 'Download Label'. The label was also emailed to you when you initiated the return.

questions: Do I have to pay to return an item?
Is there a return shipping fee?
answer: Standard returns within the country are **100% free**. A prepaid shipping label is provided. For international orders, the customer is responsible for return shipping costs unless the item arrived defective.

questions: Can I return an item without the original box?
I threw away the tags, can I still return it?
answer: Items should ideally be returned in their original packaging. However, if you've lost the shipping box, you can use any secure cardboard box. Please note that **product tags must still be attached** to apparel, and shoeboxes must be intact for footwear.

questions: Can you refund to a different card?
My bank account is closed, how do I get my refund?
My credit card expired, where does the refund go?
answer: Refunds must be processed back to the **original payment method**. If your card has expired or the account is closed, your bank will automatically reroute the funds to your new card or checking account. We cannot manually issue it to a different card for security reasons.

questions: How do I track my order?
I want to know where my order is
answer:
You can track your order in two ways:
- **App/Website**: Go to **My Orders → Track Package**
- **Email/SMS**: Use the tracking link sent to you after dispatch.

Delivery times vary by location:
- **Metro cities**: 2–4 business days
- **Tier-2 cities**: 4–6 business days
- **Remote areas**: 6–10 business days
- **International**: 7–21 business days

questions: Why is my order taking so long?
I am frustrated my package is late!
Why is my delivery taking so long
I'm upset about the late delivery
When will I get my order
answer: We apologize for the delay! If tracking shows no update for 3+ business days, the package might be delayed in transit. Please contact support with your order ID so we can investigate with the courier. If deemed lost, we will reship or refund.

questions: What is the free shipping threshold?
answer: ShopEase offers **free standard shipping** on all orders above ₹499 (domestic). For orders below ₹499, a flat shipping fee of ₹49 applies. Express delivery is available at ₹99.

questions: Which countries do you ship to?
Can you ship to my country?
answer: Yes! ShopEase ships to **45+ countries** worldwide. International delivery typically takes 7–21 business days depending on the destination. Customs duties may apply and are the responsibility of the buyer.

questions: I put the wrong shipping address, how do I change it?
Can I update my delivery address?
Need to change where my order is going
answer: Order modifications, including address changes, are only possible **before the order is shipped**. Go to **My Orders → Edit Order** as soon as possible. If it's already dispatched, we cannot change the address.

questions: Do you ship to PO Boxes?
Can I use an APO/FPO address?
answer: Yes, we ship to PO Boxes and APO/FPO addresses via standard postal services. Please note that express shipping is not available for these addresses, and delivery may take slightly longer.

questions: Will my package arrive on Sunday?
answer: Delivery days depend on the courier. Most couriers deliver Monday through Saturday. Sunday deliveries are only available in select metro areas for specific express shipments.

questions: How do I cancel an order?
Stop my order before it ships
answer: Orders can be cancelled **within 1 hour** of being placed. Go to **My Orders → Cancel Order**. After 1 hour, if the order is dispatched, you must wait for delivery and initiate a return.

questions: This is not what I ordered!
This is not what I ordered
You sent me the wrong thing
answer: We apologize for the mix-up! Please go to **My Orders → Report an Issue → Wrong Item Received**. We will arrange a free pickup and ship the correct item to you immediately.

questions: I haven't received an order confirmation email
answer: Order confirmations are emailed within 15 minutes. Check your spam folder. You can also verify your order by logging into **My Account → My Orders**. If payment was deducted but no order appears, contact support.

questions: How do I modify my order?
I want to add something to my order
answer: Once placed, we cannot add or remove items from an order. You can cancel the entire order within 1 hour and place a new one, or place a second separate order for the additional items.

questions: How do I see my order history?
Where can I view past orders?
answer: You can view all your past and present orders by going to **My Account → My Orders**. Your complete purchase history is stored securely in your account.

questions: Can I get a gift receipt?
How do I hide the price for a gift?
answer: Yes! At checkout, check the box that says 'This is a gift'. We will include a gift receipt without prices and hide the price on the packing slip.

questions: Can I order without an account?
How do I track a guest order?
answer: Yes, you can checkout as a guest. To track a guest order, use the tracking link provided in your shipping confirmation email, or go to the 'Track Order' page and enter your order number and email address.

questions: Can I place a bulk order?
answer: For bulk, corporate, or wholesale orders (quantities > 20 per item), please contact our B2B team at **wholesale@shopease.com** for special pricing and availability.

questions: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, UPI, Net Banking, and select Buy Now Pay Later options.

questions: Money was deducted but my order failed
answer: Payments can fail due to incorrect card details, insufficient funds, or bank network issues. If money was deducted for a failed order, it will be automatically refunded by your bank within 5-7 business days.
EMI is available on orders above ₹3,000. We offer No-Cost EMI on select credit cards (3, 6, 9 months) and standard EMI on all major cards. Options appear at checkout.

questions: How do I get an invoice?
Can I get a GST invoice?
answer: You can download your invoice anytime by going to **My Orders → Order Details → Download Invoice**. GST invoices are automatically generated.

questions: Can I split payment between two cards?
How to use multiple payment methods?
answer: We currently do not support splitting a single order across multiple credit or debit cards. However, you can use a Gift Card or Wallet balance and pay the remaining amount with a credit card.

questions: How do I reset my password?
I'm locked out of my account
answer: To reset your password, go to the Login page and click **Forgot Password**. Enter your email to receive a reset link. If you don't see it, check your spam folder.

questions: How do I delete my account?
I want to close my ShopEase account
answer: To delete your account, go to **My Account → Settings → Delete Account**. Note that this action is permanent and your data will be removed. Active orders must be completed first.

questions: How do I update my email address?
Can I change my phone number?
answer: Go to **My Account → Profile → Edit Profile**. For email/phone changes, you will receive a verification OTP to confirm the change for security purposes.

questions: Why is my coupon not working?
How do I apply a voucher?
answer: Promo codes may fail if they are expired, single-use, don't meet minimum order value, or are applied to items already on sale. Codes are also case-sensitive.

questions: I found this cheaper somewhere else
answer: We currently do not offer price matching with competitors. However, if the price of an item you purchased drops on our site within 7 days of your order, contact us for a store credit of the difference.

questions: When will this product be back in stock?
Can I be notified when the item is restocked?
answer: If a product shows Out of Stock, you can click **Notify Me** on the product page to receive an email when it's restocked. Restock timelines vary by supplier.
Select items are available for pre-order. You will be charged immediately upon placing the pre-order, and the item will ship by the estimated shipping date shown on the product page.

questions: Do your products come with a warranty?
My product broke, is it under warranty?
answer: Electronics and appliances come with a standard 1-year manufacturer warranty. Clothing and accessories are covered by our 30-day return policy. For warranty claims, contact the manufacturer directly or reach out to us for assistance.

answer: We guarantee that all perishable goods and cosmetics will have at least 6 months remaining before their expiration date when delivered to you.

questions: Where can I find the ingredients?
What material is this dress made of?
answer: Full material compositions and ingredient lists are available under the **Product Specifications** tab on every product page.

answer: Furniture and large appliances may require assembly. We offer free professional installation for large appliances in select metro areas. For furniture, an assembly guide is included in the box.

questions: How do I buy an e-gift card?
answer: Yes! We offer E-Gift Cards ranging from ₹500 to ₹10,000. They are delivered instantly via email and have no expiration date. You can purchase them from the 'Gift Cards' section in the main menu.

questions: How do I become a premium member?
answer: ShopEase Plus is our premium membership that offers free express shipping on all orders, early access to sales, and exclusive discounts for ₹999/year. You can subscribe from your account dashboard.

questions: How do I cancel my ShopEase Plus membership?
I want to stop my subscription
answer: To cancel your membership, go to **My Account → ShopEase Plus → Cancel Subscription**. Your benefits will remain active until the end of your current billing cycle.

questions: How does subscribe and save work?
Can I get this delivered every month?
answer: Subscribe & Save lets you set up automatic deliveries for everyday essentials at a 5% discount. You can choose the delivery frequency (e.g., every 1, 2, or 3 months) and cancel or skip a delivery at any time.

questions: Can I skip a month for my subscription?
How do I pause my recurring order?
answer: Yes! Go to **My Account → Subscriptions**, select your active subscription, and click 'Skip Next Delivery'. You won't be charged for that cycle.

questions: How do I unsubscribe from emails?
answer: You can unsubscribe from marketing emails by clicking the 'Unsubscribe' link at the bottom of any promotional email, or by updating your preferences in **My Account → Communications**.

questions: How do I check my store credit?
answer: You can view your store credit balance by logging in and navigating to **My Account → ShopEase Wallet**. The balance will also automatically appear as a payment option during checkout.

questions: How long do I have to use my wallet balance?
answer: Store credit issued from refunds never expires. However, promotional wallet cashback or referral bonuses usually expire within 90 days. Check the exact expiry dates in your Wallet history.

questions: Can I transfer my store credit to my bank account?
How do I withdraw wallet money?
answer: Refunds issued to your ShopEase Wallet can be transferred to your original bank account within 30 days. However, promotional cashback and referral bonuses cannot be withdrawn and must be spent on the platform.

questions: How does the refer and earn program work?
How do I get my referral bonus?
answer: Share your unique referral code from **My Account → Refer & Earn**. Your friend gets ₹100 off their first order, and you receive ₹150 in your Wallet once their order is delivered.

questions: How do I earn reward points?
answer: You earn 1 point for every ₹10 spent. Points are credited 3 days after delivery. At checkout, you can redeem them (100 points = ₹1) to pay for up to 20% of your order value.

questions: What is your customer care number?
answer: You can reach our human support team via email at **support@shopease.com** or call our toll-free helpline at **1800-123-4567** (Mon-Sat, 9 AM - 6 PM).
ShopEase is primarily an online platform, but we do have flagship experience centers in Mumbai, Delhi, and Bangalore. You can find the exact addresses on our 'Store Locator' page.

questions: I have a suggestion for your app
answer: We'd love to hear from you! You can submit feedback or suggestions via the 'Send Feedback' form in the Help Center, or email us directly at feedback@shopease.com.

questions: How can I apply for a job?
answer: We're always looking for great talent! Please visit our Careers page at careers.shopease.com to view open positions and submit your resume.
